title.note: Game title, kept byte-identical per the glossary (brand).
title.blind_remark: left in English; not translated into Burmese

hud.cast.note: ပစ်ချ = throw (the line) down into the water; pairs with ဆွဲတင် (pull up) on hud.reel. Button form verb + ရန်. If ပစ်ချ reads as 'throw away' to a native, ချိတ်ချရန် ('lower the hook', 7 chars) is the alternative.
hud.cast.blind_remark: literally 'to throw down / drop'; a generic verb, out of context it could read as 'throw away'

hud.reel.note: ဆွဲတင် = pull up / haul in, the fishing sense of Reel; same verb as the pass name pass.auto_reel.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form 'Bait {count}', correct for 0, 1 and more; classifier dropped to fit the HUD counter, as the guide allows.

catch.success.note: 'Caught {rarity} {fish}!' with no 'you'; rarity is a noun-like modifier before the fish name (ရှားပါး ရွှေငါးကြင်း မိပြီ!). No article, so the English a/an issue does not arise.

catch.escaped.note: 'The fish got away...'; 'it' made explicit with the generic word ငါး (fish), as the context allows.

catch.new_record.text: စံချိန်သစ်! {weight} ကီလို
catch.new_record.note: kg written ကီလို, the everyday Burmese word for kilogram; Latin kg would also be understood. {weight} with a decimal point (12.4) reads fine in Burmese.

fish.golden_carp.note: ရွှေ (golden) + ငါးကြင်း (carp), built like ရွှေငါး (goldfish). Native check that ငါးကြင်း is the carp players know.

fish.lantern_eel.text: မီးအိမ်ငါးရှဉ့်
fish.lantern_eel.note: မီးအိမ် (lantern) + ငါးရှဉ့် (eel), translated per the glossary decision; keeps the glowing-lantern idea. Closed compound per the guide.

rarity.mythic.text: နတ်ဒဏ္ဍာရီ
rarity.mythic.note: Burmese for 'mythology' (myths of the nats); it builds on ဒဏ္ဍာရီ (Legendary) so it reads as the tier above. Native check: if it feels too folk-religious, Mythic in Latin (as in Mobile Legends ranks, where Mythic is above Legend) is the fallback.
rarity.mythic.blind_remark: a noun, not an adjective like 'mythic'; it contains the word for 'legend', so it may be hard to tell apart from a Legendary tier

shop.rods.note: Fishing rod; tab label as a bare noun, no plural marker, as Burmese tabs write it.

shop.equip.note: 'Use' (သုံး) + button ရန်; plainer for kids than တပ်ဆင်ရန် (install/fit). Pairs with shop.equipped သုံးနေဆဲ.

shop.equipped.note: State label 'in use' (ဆဲ = still / in progress, as in status labels); distinct from the shop.equip button.

shop.buy_robux.text: {price} Robux ဖြင့် ဝယ်ရန်
shop.buy_robux.note: Guide reference pattern: verb last, literary ဖြင့် to match the ရန် button form.

pass.auto_reel.text: အလိုအလျောက် ဆွဲတင်
pass.auto_reel.note: 'Automatic pull-up', same verb ဆွဲတင် as hud.reel. Auto in Latin (Auto ဆွဲတင်) is common gamer speech but fails the lint script check. The Creator Hub store name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.note: 'Lucky Bait doubles the chance of catching rare fish'; 'your' dropped, chance rendered as မိနိုင်ခြေ (likelihood of catching). Pass name built from ကံ (luck) and ငါးစာ (Bait).

sell.all.text: အကုန်ရောင်းရန်
sell.all.note: 'Sell all' with everyday အကုန် (all) to fit 12; the Android-style အားလုံး ရောင်းရန် is 13.

sell.done.text: ငါး {count} ကောင် ရောင်းပြီး ဒင်္ဂါး {coins} ပြား ရပြီ!
sell.done.note: 'Sold {count} fish and got {coins} coins!' Classifiers ကောင် (animals) and ပြား (coins) are correct for 1 and for any number.

sell.prompt.text: ရောင်းရန် E နှိပ်ပါ
sell.prompt.note: Guide pattern 'to sell, press E'; E kept. Developer: phone and console players have no E key; ProximityPrompt ActionText alone would serve them.

ascend.button.text: အဆင့်မြှင့်ရန်
ascend.button.note: အဆင့်မြှင့် = raise your rank, a non-religious, non-climbing word for prestige (ကြွ is the religious 'ascend'). If players read it as a plain upgrade, the guide's Rebirth precedent suggests Ascend in Latin + လုပ် as the fallback.
ascend.button.blind_remark: literally 'raise the level/rank'; the everyday word for an upgrade, nothing in it suggests a reset

ascend.confirm.text: အခု အဆင့်မြှင့်မလား။ အစကနေ ပြန်စရမယ်၊ ဒါပေမယ့် ရှားပါးငါးတွေ {bonus}% ပိုမိမယ်။
ascend.confirm.note: 'Ascend now? You start again from the beginning, but you catch rare fish {bonus}% more.' 'more often' rendered as ပိုမိ (catch more), the same rate. Question with လား + ။ per the guide; same Ascend word as the button.

weather.storm.note: စာဟပ် = fish snap at the bait (fishing sense of 'biting'), also used in tip.night. Alternative: ငါးစာ ကိုက်နေပြီ.

quest.title.note: Guide vocabulary for quest (marked unverified there); bare noun for the panel title, no plural marker.

quest.catch_n.text: လရောင်ကမ်းကွေ့မှာ ငါး {n} ကောင် ဖမ်းပါ
quest.catch_n.note: Moonlit Bay translated per the glossary as လရောင်ကမ်းကွေ့ ('Moonlight Cove'; ကမ်းကွေ့ = curve of the shore, a lake bay rather than a sea gulf). Classifier ကောင် works for n = 1. Quest line is a label, so no ။.
quest.catch_n.blind_remark: Burmese has no capitals, so it is unclear whether this is a named place or just 'the moonlit bend of the shore'

quest.claim.note: 'Receive', the guide's Claim; never တောင်းဆို.

friends.boost.text: သူငယ်ချင်းတွေနဲ့ ငါးမျှားရင် ကံ +{percent}% ရမယ်
friends.boost.note: 'If you fish with friends you get luck +{percent}%', a statement; ကံ = luck, the same word inside ကံကောင်းငါးစာ (Lucky Bait). Info line, so no ။.

trade.sent.text: {player} ကို လဲလှယ်ဖို့ တောင်းဆိုလိုက်ပြီ
trade.sent.note: 'Asked {player} to trade', the natural Burmese for a sent request; no gender. ကို after the name with a space (house rule).

trade.accept.text: {player} က လဲလှယ်မှုကို လက်ခံလိုက်ပြီ
trade.accept.note: '{player} accepted the trade'; 'your' dropped, no gender agreement exists.

codes.enter.text: ကုဒ် ထည့်ပါ

codes.redeemed.note: 'Code worked! Have fun with your reward.' Avoids ကုဒ် သုံးပြီးပြီ, which would read as the error 'code already used'.
codes.redeemed.review_reason: ကုဒ် အောင်မြင်ပြီ says the code itself succeeded, which reads oddly; success toasts name the action, so ကုဒ် သုံးတာ အောင်မြင်ပြီ (using the code worked) is the natural form and still cannot be read as the already-used error.

afk.kicked.note: 'You stayed a long time without moving, so fishing stopped.' Idle rendered as not moving (as in the guide's AFK line); no mention of being removed from the server.

settings.back.note: The usual app Back label; ပိတ်ရန် (Close) also fits if the button closes the panel.
settings.back.blind_remark: formal wording; the root word also means 'next / later', so it could be misread as 'Next'

settings.sfx.note: 'Sound', the usual Burmese game-settings label for effects beside ဂီတ (Music); a literal 'sound effects' phrase is long and stiff.
settings.sfx.blind_remark: generic 'sound / voice'; does not say sound effects as opposed to music

event.ends.text: ပြီးဖို့ {time} ကျန်တယ်
event.ends.note: '{time} left until it ends', the guide's countdown pattern. Developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h'; for this locale format it as '2 ရက် 4 နာရီ' (CLDR units).
event.ends.blind_remark: no subject; could read as time left for you to finish something rather than the event ending

daily.streak.text: ဆက်တိုက် {day} ရက်မြောက်! ဆုလာဘ် ထပ်ယူဖို့ မနက်ဖြန် ပြန်လာခဲ့နော်!
daily.streak.note: 'Day {day} in a row!' as an ordinal (ရက်မြောက် = the nth day), correct for day 1. 'for more' made explicit as more rewards (ဆုလာဘ်); နော် is the friendly 'okay?' from the guide.

tip.night.text: အကြံပြုချက် : တချို့ ငါးတွေက ညဘက်မှပဲ စာဟပ်တယ်။
tip.night.note: Tip label အကြံပြုချက် with a space before the colon (Microsoft style). စာဟပ် = take the bait, as in weather.storm.

group.join.text: Community ထဲ ဝင်ပြီး ငါးစာ 50 ခု အခမဲ့ ရယူပါ!
group.join.note: group rendered Community, the English name players see in Roblox (no Burmese Roblox UI), per the guide; အဖွဲ့ if the game's other UI says group. ခု = classifier for the bait units.
group.join.blind_remark: the word 'Community' is left in English, in Latin script, mid-sentence

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Heaviest fish', since the board ranks by weight; အကြီးဆုံး (biggest) could be read as length.
